title: what tantra actually is
hook: set the rumor down and open an actual Tantra
tomorrow: anyone can read a Tantra. so why does it say reading isn't enough?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the Yoga Vasistha closed: Rama, freed while living, sent back into his work. Today, a new part of the path, and a word with a reputation.
screen: `NOT AWAY FROM THE WORLD, BUT THROUGH IT.`

segments.voice: Say the word tantra at a party and sometimes people smirk. Online it sells weekend workshops and racy book covers. So set the rumor down for a minute and open an actual Tantra. The Kularnava Tantra begins on a mountain. The goddess turns to Shiva with a question about beings caught in the round of birth and death, suffering, unable to find a way out. How can they be freed? That's the opening move.
screen: `A WORD WITH A REPUTATION.` → `OPEN AN ACTUAL TANTRA.` → `HOW CAN SUFFERING BEINGS BE FREED?`

segments.voice: So what is tantra, actually? Start plain. A Tantra, with a capital T, is a book, a sacred text, one of a family of them. The ones this run visits are framed as conversations between Shiva and the goddess, one asking, one answering. Then look at what fills the pages: how a student receives a mantra from a teacher, how to draw a sacred diagram, how to worship the goddess or Shiva step by step, how to meditate on the divine within the body. The stuff of worship. Beneath it sits a way of seeing, as tantric teachers describe it: the world isn't a trap to climb out of. Its energy is the goddess's own power, so the path runs through ordinary life, body and all. A Jewish neighbor would recognize one piece of that. Ecclesiastes says: 'Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy.' Ordinary life, bread and all, received as good. That much is shared. The honest difference: in Ecclesiastes the joy is a gift of the one God, who has already accepted your works, as the verse goes on to say. The Tantras speak of the world as the goddess's own power, and build a whole practice of mantra, diagram and meditation on it. So for the coming days the word carries three meanings: a kind of book, the practices it teaches, and the way of seeing they grow from.
screen: `A TANTRA IS A BOOK.` · `MANTRA, DIAGRAM, WORSHIP, MEDITATION.` · `THE WORLD AS THE GODDESS'S POWER.` · `ECCLESIASTES: EAT THY BREAD WITH JOY.` · then, large: `A BOOK BEFORE A RUMOR.`

segments.voice: Sit upright, palms resting on your knees, and let your attention travel slowly from your feet to the top of your head. Don't fix anything; just notice the body as a place you're living in right now. If you pray, you can let that noticing be your prayer.
What tantra actually is: a kind of sacred book, the practices it teaches, and the way of seeing beneath them.
Your line: what tantra actually is. A sacred book first, before it's ever a rumor. Day sixteen-oh-nine.
